intent: Build a voice-driven control layer for macOS where Jev is the universal fallback rather than the router. The immediate goal is the Rust port of the proven Python accessibility driver, at parity, so that nothing downstream rests on code that cannot be verified. Emma, the voice front end, follows on top once the observation and execution layers are trustworthy.
blocked_by: Owner review. prd, arch and plan are drafted but unapproved, so build cannot start. T1 is DONE - the objc2 spike answered yes, so the dependency risk that used to block here is gone.
notes: T1 answered YES on 2026-09-20: objc2-application-services exposes all four AX entry points and they were called against five live apps. The accessibility-sys fallback is dropped. Evidence in docs/memory.md D8.
CI is green: 9 tests, clippy clean, fmt clean, on a real GitHub runner (public repo = free Actions).

The repo went public on 2026-09-20: Actions is free and unlimited for public repositories, and the private budget was exhausted. The sensitive parts were scrubbed first - private project names became generic examples, secret-store paths were genericised, and an absolute path became relative. Licensed Apache-2.0.
Unchanged: prd, arch and plan are still drafts awaiting owner review. The gate is at prd, and the next real task is T2.
